transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

I came in because my thoughts and speech have been hard for people to follow. In my artist statements or client notes, I’ll start talking about textures, then suddenly budgets, then what I think something secretly means. It happens in meetings too. People keep telling me they lose track of what I’m trying to explain.
When your thoughts jump around like that, does it feel like your mind is racing or moving much faster than usual?
Yes. It can feel like everything is coming at once—images, titles, grant wording, colors, bits of conversations—and they stack up before I’ve finished the first thought.
During these times when your mind is racing, do you find that you need much less sleep than usual without feeling tired?
Yes. I’ll sometimes sleep only two or three hours after working late, then wake up feeling bright and ready to keep going. I’m not tired the way I normally would be.
Have you ever had periods in your life when you felt deeply down, depressed, or lost interest in things you usually enjoy?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed a period like that, at least not clearly.
Has there ever been another time in your life when you experienced this kind of unusually high energy and racing thoughts?
Yes. I’ll suddenly take on three proposals at once, reorganize the whole studio, sketch all night, email curators, and start cutting materials for pieces I haven’t even budgeted for yet.
Between these periods of high energy, does your mood and energy return to what is normal for you?
Not really. Looking back, those energized, irritable, super-productive stretches have taken up more of the year than the calmer times, even though they do go up and down in intensity.
For how many years have you been experiencing these fluctuations in your energy and mood?
About a year and two months, I think. It started around when I switched from community curation to doing independent installation work full-time.
During those calmer stretches, did you ever notice feeling unusually sluggish, low in energy, or unmotivated?
I’m not sure I’d call it unusually low. I do have calmer stretches, but I haven’t really noticed being especially sluggish or unable to get motivated.
Before this started about a year and two months ago, had you ever experienced an episode of unusually high energy or mood changes?
I don’t think so. At least, nothing like what’s been happening over the past year or so.
Over the past year, was there ever a stretch of at least two months where your mood, thoughts, and energy completely returned to your normal self?

No, I don’t think there was a full two months where I felt completely back to normal. The more energized, irritable, really productive periods have taken up more of the year than the calmer ones, even though they do get more or less intense.
Looking back over this past year and two months, has this felt like one continuous, ongoing period of illness with varying intensity, rather than separate, distinct episodes?

Yeah, it’s felt more like one ongoing thing than separate episodes. It started around a year and two months ago, when I switched from community curation to doing independent installation work full-time, and it’s kind of continued since then.
